name: Shopmonkey
summary: Shop management software for auto repair shops: estimates and invoices, digital vehicle inspections, customer texting, parts lookup and ordering, inventory, labor guides and integrated payments.
best_for: independent auto repair, tire and fleet service shops with roughly 3 to 6 staff who want estimates, inspections, customer texting, parts ordering and payments in one system
skip_if: you want to try the software before talking to sales, you need a published card-processing rate to compare, or you only need simple invoicing
honest_knock: Card processing is part of the product, but the online and in-person payment rates are 'Call for Pricing' on every plan, so you cannot work out the full monthly cost from the page. Inventory, purchase orders and unlimited inspections are not in the $215 Basic plan, a $500 migration fee and $299 card readers come on top, and there is no free trial or self-serve signup, only a demo. We have not used Shopmonkey ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month billed annually, 3 user licences
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-11 on shopmonkey.io/pricing, USD) Three published plans for auto repair shops and a Multi-Shop plan on quote. Billed annually, which the page says saves up to 10%: Basic $215 a month, Clever $359, Genius $449. Billed monthly: $239, $399 and $499. Basic includes 3 user licences, Clever 4 and Genius 5, and each additional user is $20 a month on all three. Basic covers two-way text and email, unlimited estimates and invoices, a calendar with automated reminders, 2 digital vehicle inspection templates, electronic signatures, integrated payments, parts lookup and ordering and the mobile app. Clever adds a customisable workflow, unlimited inspections, labor guides, inventory management, purchase orders, time clock tracking and the built-in QuickBooks Online and ALLDATA integrations. Genius adds a Google reviews manager, diagrams and procedures, automated estimate follow-ups, inactive work orders, a coupons manager, audit logs and what the page calls the lowest payment rates. A one-time $500 data migration fee applies. The card reader is $299 plus $10 a month per device, with a further $10 a month per device for cellular, and online and in-person payment fees are listed as 'Call for Pricing' on every plan. QuickBooks Desktop integration is an additional fee. Paid add-ons for any plan: CRM Essentials and Bookkeeping at $314 a month each billed annually ($349 monthly), Accounting at $89 ($99), and Heavy Duty on custom pricing. Every plan button on the page leads to a demo request; there is no self-serve signup or free trial on the pricing page.

cost_traps.label: Key features are paid add-ons
cost_traps.evidence: Paid add-ons for any plan: CRM Essentials and Bookkeeping at $314 a month each billed annually ($349 monthly), Accounting at $89 ($99), and Heavy Duty on custom pricing.

compare_with.name: Housecall Pro
compare_with.why: Housecall Pro is in our dossiers too, but it is a general field-service app for trades that drive to the customer. Shopmonkey is built for vehicles coming into the bay, with VIN decode, vehicle inspections, labor guides and parts ordering. A car repair shop should compare Shopmonkey with other auto-shop systems rather than with a general field-service app.
